name: lfx-mos-website
description: LFX Marketing OS · Website: renders a Linux Foundation project's static website from its messaging framework, boilerplates, FAQ and brand kit, audits it for WCAG 2.2 AA, makes it agent-ready (Markdown twins, Link headers and Markdown negotiation at the edge), and packages it for Marketing OS, LF GitHub, a separate GitHub, or WordPress. Blog posts and events with a rich-text editor. Companion to lfx-mos-brand-positioning.
